packageRules.description: Our apps' releases deploy themselves at any version: Flux smoke-tests them and revert-pin undoes a failure.
k3s: patch releases go on their own (system-upgrade-controller, node by node); minors and majors wait for a person.
Nextcloud: the chart and the image move together, one major at a time.
Postgres majors need a dump and restore (or CloudNativePG's major upgrade): a person decides.
The k3s upgrade image follows the Plan's version, not a tag of its own.
